name: Critical Isovalue Detection
definition: Critical isovalues are isovalue levels where the topology of the isosurface changes, specifically: creation of new surface components (at local minima/maxima), merging of surface components, or formation of holes in a surface component (at saddles).
summary: Critical Isovalue Detection identifies scalar values where isosurface topology changes, distinguishing itself by focusing solely on these events rather than generating geometry.
